title: T-Rex
provider: Niu, Liu, Wang et al. 2026 (UC Berkeley)
about: Teleoperated bimanual robot with two Sharpa Wave hands, five camera-based fingertip tactile sensors per hand; 5,464 episodes over 22 motor primitives and 207 objects.

hardware.d: 5 fingertip tactile sensors per hand · raw image, deformation map, 6-axis wrench · 30 Hz
2 × 7-DoF arms; wheels, torso and head fixed during collection

hardware.v: Head ZED X Mini + 2 wrist ZED X One S

hardware.d: Language caption, motor primitive and object per episode

notes: Paper: arXiv 2606.17055. Released under the MIT license. Each episode is a slice of the release's multi-episode video files, re-encoded and hosted here; all three tactile streams are shown: the fingertip deformation map pooled to 10 × 10 cells, the 6-axis wrench (arrow, ring and plots) and the raw sensor images.
